Maya (AE): Hey team — running into a model-fit question for a deal with Nova Health. They want to evaluate our platform for a 30-day trial. Primary ask: can we serve their preferred model family (cobalt-7B and cobalt-7B-chat variants) with our Dedicated plan, and what are the blockers for a private/VPC deployment? They also attached their security questionnaire (see below).

Raj (SE): Quick summary from initial call: they need 99th percentile latency <150ms for 512-token generation, vector embeddings for retrieval, and on-prem options for PHI. They're asking if quantized variants are allowed for their compliance needs and licensing for commercial use.

Kat (Eng-ML): Short answer: cobalt-7B-q4a (4-bit) works on our runtime but latency/accuracy tradeoffs differ from fp16. For 512 tokens at QPS ~10 you'll need a T4x2 or A10x1 profile on Dedicated; for strict 150ms P99 you'll want A100 or our Dedicated GPU pool with batching tuned. Quantized models are okay if licence permits commercial redeploy; need to confirm cobalt's license — I think it's permissive but check.

Ethan (Infra): For private/VPC we support our Private bundle. Two notes:
- KMS: we can integrate customer KMS/HSM via our KMS connector (we need their KMS endpoint + allowed IPs)
- Networking: must allow outbound to our control plane for audit logs unless they want fully air-gapped on-prem (that requires our air-gap package and extra lead time ~4-6 weeks)

Maya (AE): They flagged a line in the security questionnaire about model provenance and ML supply chain. What do we need to provide? They also asked about data residency in EU.

Kat (Eng-ML): Provide model provenance: model name, training dataset summary (we host curated open models; include upstream repo & fingerprint), and quantization process (toolchain + checksum). For EU residency — yes, we have EU region hosts and Private can be deployed in their VPC in eu-west-1; for on-prem we can run in their DC.

Raj (SE): Pricing question: they're asking for a blended rate for the 30-day trial that covers both embeddings and generation plus a one-time Private onboarding fee. We typically offer a trial credit + discounted Dedicated hourly for pilots. I'll draft numbers after Kat/Ethan confirm infra footprint.

Kat (Eng-ML): Draft model config snippet we tested in staging:
```
model: cobalt-7B-q4a
max_tokens: 512
batching: dynamic
kv_cache: enabled
quantize_tool: q-fast-v2
expected_mem: 10GB
recommended_gpu: a10 (1) / a100 (1) for low-latency
```

Ethan (Infra): Deploy checklist for Private trial:
- Provide customer VPC peering details + CIDR
- KMS public endpoint + certs
- SLA/ops contact and on-call rotation for trial
- Expected QPS and seq len (they said 10 QPS, 512 tokens)
Once we have those, we can spin a Dedicated pool in EU and test.

Maya (AE): Security Q still open: they want confirmation on log retention and ability to disable telemetry. Can we toggle telemetry for Private?

Kat (Eng-ML): Yes — Private installs can opt-out of telemetry and set audit log retention per contract. We'll need to list what logs are captured by default (request metadata excluding payload by default; full payload logging only with explicit consent).

Raj (SE): Action items:
- Raj: confirm model license for commercial use w/ legal (ETA EOD)
- Ethan: prep Private deployment runbook + cost estimate for A10/A100 footprint (ETA tomorrow morning)
- Kat: run latency test on cobalt-7B-q4a in EU region and share P99 numbers (ETA 24h)
- Maya: send them a draft trial SOW + ask for KMS/VPC details

SecBot (automated): Uploaded file: nova_security_questionnaire.pdf (70KB)

Maya (AE): Thanks — I'll get the questionnaire answers started and loop in legal. If anyone hits a hard blocker on licensing or latency we'll escalate to product. :thumbsup!
